completePrintedEditionConstraint.scope: Complete Jitabang printed edition, including the fifth-ending melody at m41–42
completePrintedEditionConstraint.result: At least nine melody pitch classes cannot map into the seven natural pitch classes under any of the 12 global transpositions. An octave shift does not remove that constraint.
completePrintedEditionConstraint.currentEncodingVerdict: This is not a chromatic rejection of the current all-natural 73-note encoding, proof that its notes were naturalized, or a verdict on every Katyusha edition.
